content.text: Many digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya face [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-2|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] restrictions when trying to sell ebooks, courses, and software online — platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable or severely restricted. This creates a significant barrier to entry for those who want to monetize their digital products without relying on centralized payment processors. The cost of using these platforms can be substantial, with Gumroad charging 10% on every sale, and NOWPayments offering a significantly lower 0.5% fee. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-selling-stock-photos-without-7|The Real]] retains $921. This post explores the real [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-5|architecture]] behind Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery, a solution that allows creators to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack without depending on platforms like Stripe or PayPal.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-guide-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

Cloudflare R2 is a serverless object storage platform that allows digital creators to store and deliver their products without relying on centralized payment processors. Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges only 0.5%. This means that at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921.
How do I set up Cloudflare R2 for object storage?

To set up Cloudflare R2 for object storage, you will need to create a new bucket and configure it to store your digital products. You can then use the Cloudflare R2 API to upload and manage your products.
What is the difference between Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare Workers?

Cloudflare Pages is a hosting platform that allows you to host your website and e-commerce platform, while Cloudflare Workers is a serverless platform that allows you to run custom code and build backend logic. You can use both platforms together to build a fully functional e-commerce platform.
